explanation: Matches the conjecture ascribed to Ryser as stated in Steinerberger (arXiv 2402.13202) Section 1: no circulant Hadamard matrix exists for n > 4. `IsHadamard'` requires entries ±1 and M^T M = n I. `Matrix.circulant v` has entries v(i - j), the same form as the paper's display. The `research solved` tag agrees with the linked OpenAI preprint (Sept 2026), whose abstract says a real circulant Hadamard matrix has order 1 or 4, and whose Lean theorem `exists_iff_order_one_or_four` says the same for positive order. n = 0 trivially satisfies n <= 4. I read the statement and abstract, but did not check the proof. Faithful.
